hints.title: Central Tendency Distance Minimization
hints.text: Each increment or decrement moves an integer closer to a common target value. What statistical measure of central tendency minimizes absolute differences?

hints.title: Median Minimality Invariant
hints.text: The geometric median in one dimension minimizes the sum of absolute deviations, which corresponds to the middle element of the sorted collection.

hints.title: Median Deviation Summation Procedure
hints.text: Sort the array and select the median at index length divided by two. Calculate the total sum of absolute differences between each element and this median value.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: N: input element count or target integer bound
complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(N log N) time and O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Testing every potential target integer between minimum and maximum takes O(N * range) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Sorting the array finds the median in O(N log N) time and O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize that median minimizes L1 distance (sum of absolute errors), whereas mean minimizes L2 distance.
